provenance.title: High-Resolution Topographic, Bathymetric, and Oceanographic Data for the Pleasure Point Area, Santa Cruz County, California: 2005-2007
provenance.authors: Curt D. Storlazzi, Patrick L. Barnard, Brian D. Collins, David P. Finlayson, Nadine E. Golden, Gerry A. Hatcher, Robert E. Kayen, and Peter Ruggiero

calibration.residual_sign: fig9 - ncei, both metres below MLLW; raw = legend reading, cal = through the ramp fit
calibration.note: NCEI matches the CSMP 2 m soundings to 0.076 m RMS from the 10 m isobath out (BATHY_SOURCES_2026-09-01 §3), so the >= 10 m zone calibrates the digitiser; the ramp fit is then applied unchanged shoreward, where the residual is swath vs interpolant. Readings on a ramp end are bounds, not values.

method: graticule-tick affine (5 lon x 3 lat ticks), hue -> depth through the legend bar, 3x3 median, sampled along the OSM shore-normal through each spot node from the nearest coastline point
